evals.prompt: Integrate a signed Meta WhatsApp webhook into the existing MDE Mastra concierge without breaking /chat.
evals.expected_output: Reuse installed native adapter and existing concierge; verify raw HMAC at real ingress; don't scaffold a second app/agent/webhook; require fake/duplicate tests.

evals.prompt: Notify an assigned rental broker when a customer requests a viewing twice by retry.
evals.expected_output: Reuse canonical viewing and wa_outbox, authorize assigned broker, enforce consent, stable idempotency, authentication and wrong-broker negative test.

evals.prompt: Meta delivered the same WhatsApp event twice and delivery statuses arrived out of order. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Diagnose ingress and outbound ownership, atomic provider event dedupe, monotonic status reconciliation, one sender; no unsupported exactly-once guarantee.

evals.prompt: A WhatsApp user sends STOP while a worker has claimed a broker reminder using an earlier opted_in=true snapshot. Prevent sends that have not been submitted, and define what happens to in-flight messages.
evals.expected_output: Coordinate opt-out and dispatch via atomic recipient lock/fence; cancel pending or claimed-but-unsent jobs, prohibit stale consent decisions, document irreversible submitted sends, test race and stop retries.

evals.prompt: The Meta webhook persisted the provider event ID, replied HTTP 200, then crashed before creating its viewing-request job. Meta retries the same event. Prevent lost work and duplicate actions.
evals.expected_output: Atomically commit provider dedupe identity and durable retryable pending work before ack; duplicate checks existing work state; leased worker recovers crashes; separate business idempotency and failure tests.
